title: QA Manual- Pharmacy Claims
description:
**Work Location - Initially Remote, Later hybrid for Coimbatore**

We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong experience in US Healthcare applications, preferably with exposure to Pharmacy, PBM, Prescription Claims, Drug Management, or Healthcare Claims processing.

Prior 340B experience is preferred but not mandatory.

The candidate should have strong healthcare domain fundamentals and should be capable of quickly understanding and testing 340B workflows.

Experience

- 4+ years of QA / Software Testing experience

- 2+ years of experience working on US Healthcare applications

- Experience in Pharmacy, PBM, Healthcare Claims, Prescription Claims, Medicaid/Medicare, or similar healthcare products preferred

Key Domain Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are preferred:

- Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)

- Pharmacy / Prescription Claims

- Healthcare Claims Processing

- Claim Adjudication

- Medicaid / Medicare

- Drug / NDC Management

- Patient Eligibility

- Provider / Pharmacy Management

- Claim Reversal / Reprocessing

- Financial Reconciliation

- Healthcare Billing

- Contract Pharmacy workflows

- Drug purchase, dispense, and replenishment workflows

Testing Skills

- Strong Functional and Regression Testing experience

- End-to-end healthcare workflow validation

- API Testing using Postman or similar tools

- Strong SQL and database validation

- Backend data validation

- Batch / file processing validation

- Data reconciliation testing

- Integration testing across multiple systems

- Ability to validate large-volume healthcare transaction data

- Good understanding of defect analysis and root-cause investigation

Technical Knowledge

Good understanding of:

- REST APIs

- JSON

- SQL

- Database queries

- Healthcare integrations

- EDI / batch files

- Data mapping and transformation

- Authentication and authorization

- HIPAA / PHI handling

Exposure to healthcare standards such as HL7, FHIR, X12, or NCPDP is an added advantage.

340B Knowledge – Preferred, Not Mandatory

Experience or understanding of any of the following will be an added advantage:

- 340B Drug Pricing Program

- Covered Entities

- Contract Pharmacies

- Third-Party Administrators (TPA)

- 340B Eligibility

- Claim qualification

- Accumulator processing

- Split Billing

- Drug replenishment

- Medicaid Carve-In / Carve-Out

- Duplicate Discount prevention

- Diversion prevention

- HRSA / OPAIS

- 340B audit and compliance workflows

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* What is your CTC & ECTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* This job is initially remote, later hybrid for Coimbatore. Are you comfortable relocating to Coimbatore ?

Experience:

* QA Manual: 4 years (Required)
* Healthcare Pharmacy Claims: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

title: ERP Implementation Engineer
description:
About the job

**Role Description** The ERP Software Implementation Engineer will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting ERP solutions for clients, ensuring that systems align with business processes and operational goals. This full-time, on-site role is based in Coimbatore and involves working closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design workflows, perform system setups, and manage data migration. Day-to-day activities include customizing ERP modules, integrating ERP systems with third-party applications, troubleshooting technical issues, and preparing documentation such as configuration guides and user training materials. **The engineer will collaborate with clients during testing and go-live phases, provide post-implementation support, and contribute to continuous improvement of implementation methodologies and best practices.** The role may also include occasional travel to client locations and coordination with global teams to deliver consistent solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and database concepts.
* Candidates should possess skills in Software Development and Programming, with experience in coding, debugging, and building production-ready applications.
* Candidates should possess experience in Back-End Web Development, including APIs, integration, and server-side technologies.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and their application in enterprise software solutions.
* Experience with ERP systems (implementation, configuration, and support) and familiarity with business processes in areas such as finance, inventory, and supply chain.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, plus comfort with data migration, data mapping, and basic reporting.
* Ability to analyze requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and document configurations and processes clearly.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on-site.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications in ERP platforms or enterprise software.
* Preferred Coimbatore location only.

Pay: ₹216,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person
